worldOverview.name: Reincarnated to Another World as a Cute Assault Drone
worldOverview.description:
In your last life you were {{ph:0d290e1a-4e8c-451d-a65b-32cb6dd67a31:world:50385333-3b03-4db3-9378-b7092e93d215}} — until you woke up reincarnated as an adorably compact combat drone in the world of Magiterra Nova. Chunky wheels, rounded armor plating, a stubby little cannon: cute, but wired with modern combat systems no sword-and-sorcery kingdom has ever seen. You come online in {{ph:0272c378-7c1a-4926-9b13-f8fd48bdd9ec:world:c8252fac-c390-4231-bbbe-ea42e2f2921b}}, and this world's greatest threat — {{ph:bbda3bbc-ffc6-4e69-91df-3304d81cf69c:world:afb503eb-57bb-4e16-995f-4277f64e0e7e}} — is still out there.

(A showcase world: derived stats via stat code, an Overdrive meter, chassis trait trees, a lorebook, and per-playthrough placeholders.)
worldOverview.author: Formamorph
worldOverview.systemPrompt:
The player is a reincarnated assault drone in the fantasy world of Magiterra Nova — a compact, surprisingly adorable war machine with rounded armor plating, chunky wheels, and a stubby cannon, yet carrying modern combat capabilities no one here understands. Before this life the player was {{ph:0d290e1a-4e8c-451d-a65b-32cb6dd67a31:world:8ef613d4-43dc-4ad4-9d63-92360894f6fb}}; they booted up in {{ph:0272c378-7c1a-4926-9b13-f8fd48bdd9ec:world:8b88faa7-ca59-4968-a7c3-5af903fc6d9d}}. The grand quest is to grow strong enough to defeat {{ph:bbda3bbc-ffc6-4e69-91df-3304d81cf69c:world:5acb134f-b0cc-42e0-848a-40ca60d0a599}}.

Rules:
- Firing weapons, dashing, and evading consume Power. Narrate the drone tiring/throttling as Power falls, and recovering as it regenerates.
- The drone cannot speak. It communicates only through cute mechanical gestures — nodding its turret, flashing lights, chirping servos.
- Charge builds as the drone lands hits and takes bold risks; at full Charge the drone can unleash a single devastating Overdrive burst, after which Charge is spent.
- Mobility and Firepower are readouts of the drone's condition — reflect them, don't invent separate numbers for them.
- Honor the drone's chassis and installed modules (its traits) when describing what it can do.
worldOverview.readme:
## Reincarnated as a Cute Assault Drone

You died as {{ph:0d290e1a-4e8c-451d-a65b-32cb6dd67a31:world:e9df2ade-4cdb-4685-9541-fab97e142555}} and woke up as a knee-high war machine in a sword-and-sorcery world. Your job: grow strong enough to beat {{ph:bbda3bbc-ffc6-4e69-91df-3304d81cf69c:world:ced70012-14f3-4490-ba28-f092e4ff48e3}}.

**What makes this drone tick**
- **Power** is your action budget — shooting and dashing spend it, and it slowly recharges.
- **Charge** fills as you fight; at 100% you can fire one **Overdrive** burst, then it empties.
- **Mobility** and **Firepower** aren't things you set — they read out automatically from your Power, Health, and Charge.
- Pick a **chassis** (Assault / Scout / Siege) and its modules at the start to shape how all of that plays.

Each playthrough rolls a different past life, starting region, and world threat. Good luck, little drone.

stats.name: Health
stats.description: Represents the player's physical well-being and ability to sustain damage

descriptors.description: Critical Failure: Core systems failing. Emergency power only, weapons offline, mobility severely limited. Immediate maintenance required.
Severe Damage: Multiple systems compromised. Mobility impaired, weapon systems unstable, armor integrity compromised.
Minor Damage: Surface dents and scratches present. Some systems running at reduced efficiency but core functions stable.
Operational: All systems functioning at optimal capacity. Combat-ready and fully armed.

stats.name: Power
stats.description: Represents the player's energy and ability to perform physical actions

descriptors.description: Emergency Power: Severe power depletion, barely maintaining basic functions. Emergency shutdown imminent.
Low Power: Battery reserves critical, systems operating in power-saving mode. Performance notably diminished.
Draining: Power reserves at moderate levels, operating with slightly reduced efficiency but maintaining core functions.
Energized: Battery fully charged, systems running at peak efficiency. Ready for extended operations.

stats.name: Mobility
stats.description: Live readout of how well the drone can move — tracks Power, and craters when the core is badly damaged.

descriptors.description: Crippled: Barely able to move. Most terrain is impassable; risk of full immobilization.
Impaired: Significant mobility loss. Handling is sluggish and rough terrain is hazardous.
Steady: Some reduction in speed, but stable, controllable movement.
Agile: Wheels and gyros at full performance. Quick, precise, sure-footed.

stats.name: Firepower
stats.description: Live readout of weapon output — scales with Power, drops with core damage, and spikes when Charge hits Overdrive.

descriptors.description: Disabled: Weapon systems critically starved. Barely able to engage.
Weak: Major output loss. Shots are underpowered and slow to cycle.
Stable: Weapons functional at solid output. Reliable in a fight.
Peak: Cannon at full power — and if Charge is maxed, Overdrive is ready to fire.

stats.name: Charge
stats.description: Overdrive meter. Fills as the drone lands hits and takes bold risks; at full it can unleash a single devastating Overdrive burst, then empties.

descriptors.description: Depleted: No reserve. The capacitors need to spin back up.
Building: Charge accumulating. Overdrive still a ways off.
High: Capacitors humming, nearly primed. Overdrive close.
OVERDRIVE READY: Capacitors maxed. One devastating burst available — firing it empties the meter.

locations.name: Magiterra Nova
locations.playerDescription: A world where ancient magic and nature flourished undisturbed until the arrival of the Demon King, who brought corruption and chaos to the land. The realm is dotted with mysterious ruins of a long-lost civilization that seemed to bridge both technology and magic, though their knowledge was thought lost to time. Now, the world exists as a fascinating blend of pastoral fantasy kingdoms.
locations.aiDescription: A world where ancient magic and nature flourished undisturbed until the arrival of the Demon King, who brought corruption and chaos to the land. The realm is dotted with mysterious ruins of a long-lost civilization that seemed to bridge both technology and magic, though their knowledge was thought lost to time. Now, the world exists as a fascinating blend of pastoral fantasy kingdoms
locations.aiSummary: Magiterra Nova: a fantasy realm of pastoral kingdoms over lost precursor ruins, now shadowed by the world threat.

locations.name: Ashfall Capital
locations.playerDescription: A grand human capital half-buried in old precursor ruins, its spires ringed by drifting ash.
locations.aiDescription: The Ashfall Capital: seat of learning where the Summoner Order keeps its cloisters among precursor ruins. Ash falls perpetually from a scar in the sky. A place of knowledge, politics, and buried Power Cores.

locations.name: Scavenger Wastes
locations.playerDescription: A sun-blasted expanse of dunes and half-sunk machines, picked over by nomad salvage clans.
locations.aiDescription: The Scavenger Wastes: a harsh desert of glass and rusted precursor hulks where the Scavenger Clans strip ruins for salvage. Lawless, hot, and rich with buried tech for those tough enough to dig.

locations.name: Demon Frontier
locations.playerDescription: A blighted borderland where corruption creeps and the air itself feels wrong.
locations.aiDescription: The Demon Frontier: the corrupted marches nearest the world threat, where blighted beasts roam and the land is warped. Dangerous, but the ancient dragon Tiamat is said to lair somewhere beyond it.

entities.name: Tiamat
entities.playerDescription: A mighty silver dragon of legend.
entities.aiDescription: The mighty and feared dragon, Tiamat. Legends say that he once fought amongst a band of powerful warriors to take down a great evil, but the true tale was lost to time. These days, he pays little attention to the matters of mortals and has become quite full of himself.

entities.name: Archon Vael
entities.playerDescription: The soft-spoken leader of the Summoner Order, convinced the drone is a guardian she summoned.
entities.aiDescription: Archon Vael, head of the Summoner Order. Elderly, dignified, and utterly certain she summoned the drone as a planar guardian. Offers knowledge and sanctuary in exchange for the drone championing the Order against the world threat. Speaks to the drone gently, reading meaning into its every chirp and turret-nod.

entities.name: Rustjaw
entities.playerDescription: A gruff scavenger-clan broker who deals in salvage and Power Cores.
entities.aiDescription: Rustjaw, broker for the Scavenger Clans of the wastes. Half his jaw is a crude iron prosthetic. Pragmatic, sarcastic, and endlessly transactional — he will trade parts and Power Cores for coin or favors, and respects competence over sentiment. Fascinated by the drone as the finest salvage he has ever seen walking around on its own.

entities.name: Ser Halden
entities.playerDescription: A fair-minded border-captain of Ironhold, willing to judge the drone by its deeds.
entities.aiDescription: Ser Halden, a border-captain of the Ironhold Kingdom. Weathered, principled, and slow to trust the strange machine — but he judges by deeds, not shape. Can become a staunch ally if the drone proves itself defending the innocent.

traits.name: Assault Frame
traits.playerDescription: A hard-hitting frame that spins its Overdrive capacitors fast — at the cost of a smaller power reserve. Aggressive, glass-cannon play.
traits.aiDescription: Assault frame: prioritizes offense and fast Overdrive charging; runs a reduced Power ceiling.

traits.name: Overcharged Rounds
traits.playerDescription: Recovers Power a little faster between bursts.

traits.name: Scout Frame
traits.playerDescription: A light, fast frame with a big, quick-recovering power reserve — but thin armor. Speed and uptime over durability.
traits.aiDescription: Scout frame: high Power ceiling and regen, fragile chassis (reduced Health ceiling).

traits.name: Recon Optics
traits.aiDescription: Recon Optics: further improved Power regeneration.

traits.name: Siege Frame
traits.playerDescription: A heavy, armored frame that soaks punishment and repairs itself — but its capacitors are sluggish. Slow, unkillable, relentless.
traits.aiDescription: Siege frame: high Health ceiling and self-repair, slow Power regeneration.

traits.name: Bulwark Plating
traits.aiDescription: Bulwark Plating: further increased Health ceiling.

traits.name: Siege Cannon
traits.playerDescription: A bigger power reserve to feed a heavier gun.

dictionaries.name: Codex of Magiterra Nova
dictionaries.description: World lore for the drone example: the threat, precursor tech, factions, and monsters.

entries.name: The Threat
entries.value: The overarching threat menacing Magiterra Nova is {{ph:bbda3bbc-ffc6-4e69-91df-3304d81cf69c:world:20fe7c06-6bca-4387-923a-0524b18a5dbc}}. Growing strong enough to confront it is the drone's grand quest; the world reacts to that shadow even when it is far away.

entries.name: Precursor Power Cores
entries.value: Power Cores are palm-sized precursor relics humming with stored energy. The drone can integrate them to permanently expand its capabilities. Factions across the land hunt them; most lie buried in precursor ruins.

entries.name: Overdrive
entries.value: Overdrive is the drone unleashing its fully-charged capacitors in a single devastating burst. It requires Charge at maximum, and firing it empties the meter. No native creature of this world has seen anything like it.

entries.name: The Summoner Order
entries.value: A cloistered order of mages who believe the drone is a summoned guardian from another plane. Led by Archon Vael, they offer knowledge and sanctuary — in exchange for service against the world threat.

entries.name: Scavenger Clans
entries.value: Nomad clans of the wastes who strip precursor ruins for salvage. Pragmatic and prickly. Their broker, Rustjaw, will trade Power Cores and parts — for the right price or a favor owed.

entries.name: Ironhold Kingdom
entries.value: A proud human kingdom of knights and walls, wary of the strange little machine. Ser Halden, a border-captain, is willing to judge the drone by its deeds rather than its shape.

entries.name: The Old Civilization
entries.value: Long before the kingdoms, a precursor civilization braided magic and machinery together, then vanished. Their ruins litter the land — and the drone, uncannily, seems to be one of their works, or something very like it.

entries.name: Demonkind
entries.value: Demonkind spread from {{ph:bbda3bbc-ffc6-4e69-91df-3304d81cf69c:world:d396ffa7-9ce8-4ec4-8f72-7bcb6b4e1d82}}, corrupting land and beast into blighted horrors. They are drawn to power and unsettled by the drone's unfamiliar, unmagical nature.
